title: The Cloud Who Packed a Picnic

storyteller.name: Storyteller
storyteller.description: Warm, soothing adult storyteller who reads the book and answers the kids' questions

kid_older.name: Leo (Age 8)
kid_older.description: Curious 8-year-old who asks about the plot and loves guessing mysteries

kid_younger.name: Mia (Age 5)
kid_younger.description: Playful 5-year-old who notices funny and cute visual details, giggles and gasps

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: What could a cloud bring to a picnic?

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: <giggle> I want to give the little cloud a hug.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Let's open The Cloud Who Packed a Picnic.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Zadie spread a picnic blanket on the hill. Tavi brought a pear.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Ollo floated down to see. "Come and share!" called Zadie.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Ollo reached for the pear. It slipped through his fluffy arms.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Tavi stopped it with his nose. <chuckle> "A rolling picnic!" said Zadie.

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: <giggle> Tavi caught it with his nose!

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: What if Ollo tries something smaller?

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Something smaller might be easier to hold. Let's see what he tries.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Ollo tried a little cup. That slipped through, too.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Zadie picked it up. Ollo's fluffy shoulders drooped.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: The sun warmed the hill. Zadie fanned her face.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Tavi tucked his head into his shell. Ollo drifted closer.

lines.speaker: kid_older
lines.text: If Ollo floats over the blanket, could his shadow cool them down?

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: Why is Tavi peeking out of his shell?

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: His shell gives him a little shade. If Ollo moves over the blanket, his shadow might give Zadie some shade too.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: A cool patch followed Ollo across the blanket. Zadie pointed to it.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Tavi peeked out. <sigh> "Your shade could keep us cool!" said Zadie.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Ollo stretched his fluffy arms. His shade reached every corner.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: "I brought a cool spot!" he said. "Just what we needed," said Zadie.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: They shared the pear and the peaceful hill. Tavi rested beside Zadie.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Above them, Ollo curled into a cosy puff. There was a place at the picnic for everyone.

lines.speaker: kid_older
lines.text: Ollo kept his friends cool with his shadow. What could I bring to a picnic with my friends?

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: You could bring a game you love to play. Then everyone can join in.

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: <giggle> Point to Ollo. Can you stretch your arms as wide as he did?

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Think of one thing only you can bring to a friendship.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Subscribe and come back for our next story.
